description: This Java source file defines a custom Hibernate dialect class 'H2LessStrictDialect' that extends the standard H2Dialect. It customizes certain database type mappings for the H2 database to address differences and issues with default behaviors in Hibernate, mainly for testing and validation purposes.

classes.name: H2LessStrictDialect
classes.description: A subclass of Hibernate's H2Dialect that overrides specific column type registrations to ensure compatibility with the H2 database for validation purposes.
